rv.q: It is a characteristically eccentric affair, with song, movement and oodles of theatrical pizzazz. The ancient story of a man who murders his wives and keeps them in a locked chamber is flamboyantly, cheekily updated with pop culture references (from Lady Gaga to Jamie Oliver).
Review: Blue Beard Huw Turnbull Culture Theatre 3 years ago 1 min read ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ Rating: 5 out of 5.
